rounds.plain: The scoring report says catalog exclusivity is weak. The site's CC BY terms allow commercial reuse and adaptation with attribution, weakening the catalog as a moat.

The kill-check judged the catalog, articles and organic footprint as a compiled asset that could take months to recreate. The deep evidence later notes that the catalogue is non-exclusive under the published licence and that Microns marks the listing Already Sold.

risks: Microns marks the listing Already Sold.
Financial, traffic, download, workload and catalog figures are seller-stated or unverified.
The published CC BY terms permit template reuse and adaptation with attribution; rights for the full catalog and attribution-removal sales need verification.
Traffic is described as effectively 100% organic search, creating search-ranking risk.
Google AdSense account ownership cannot be transferred under its published terms; Dodo Payments transferability is unverified.
The listing says 1,980 customers while also reporting 1,975 registered accounts; revenue includes some custom work.
records.moat: The catalog, domain history, backlinks and organic rankings could form a compiled SEO asset, but the figures and backlink quality are unverified. Published CC BY terms permit third parties to reuse and adapt templates with attribution; no network effect or meaningful switching cost is evidenced.

budget.note: Historical asking price in the listing; availability is marked Already Sold.

records.next_steps: If relisted, reconcile 12 months of revenue by stream to ad-network, sponsor, payment-processor and bank records; inspect 24 months of monthly Search Console and analytics data; request owner task and time logs; and verify template rights, domain/code/hosting handover and payment-provider transfer requirements.
